sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: When connecting to a remote Linux server via SSH, graphical applications cannot be displayed locally unless X11 forwarding is properly configured on both the client and the server side.

sections.heading: Prerequisites
sections.text: SSH access to the target Linux server. An X server running on the client machine (built-in on Linux/macOS; requires Xming or similar on Windows). Sufficient privileges to edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config on the server (or access to a sudoer account).

sections.heading: Client
sections.text: Ensure that the SSH client has the X11 forwarding option enabled before connecting. MobaXterm / Linux SSH client: X11 forwarding is typically enabled by default or via the session settings. Putty: Putty does not include a built-in X server. Xming must be installed and running separately. Enable X11 forwarding under Connection → SSH → X11 → Enable X11 forwarding .

sections.heading: Server
sections.text: 1. Enable X11 Forwarding in SSHD Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config and ensure the following directive is present and not commented out: X11Forwarding yes Restart the SSH daemon after any change to this file: sudo systemctl restart sshd 2. Authorise the Target User Once connected with X11 forwarding active, grant the target OS user access to the current X display: sudo -u <os_user> xauth add `xauth list $DISPLAY` 3. Verify the DISPLAY Variable Confirm that the DISPLAY environment variable is correctly propagated for the target user: sudo -u <os_user> echo $DISPLAY Expected output example: :10.0 or localhost:10.0 . 4. Test the Forwarded Display Launch a minimal X application to confirm the full chain is working: sudo -u <os_user> xterm An xterm window should open on the local desktop.

sections.heading: Verification
sections.text: Check Expected Result X11Forwarding yes present in /etc/ssh/sshd_config Directive uncommented and set to yes echo $DISPLAY for target user Returns a non-empty value such as localhost:10.0 xterm launches A terminal window appears on the local X display

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: the SSH session was not started with X11 forwarding enabled. Reconnect using DISPLAY is empty: ssh -X user@host or enable the option in the client. install the xauth command not found: xauth package ( dnf install xorg-x11-xauth on RHEL/Rocky). install the xterm command not found: xterm package ( dnf install xterm ). Xming not displaying on Windows: ensure Xming is started before opening the SSH session in Putty.
